ad_info.structure_source: library format F40 (Carta de texto), winning structure mv-08
ad_info.reference_style: Text-letter ad: a bold two-line headline at the top left, a short letter in white with bold phrases on the left, the bottle cut out and tilted on the right edge, a signature in italic

global_identity.color_palette: Dark plum #2B1226 (background), hot fuchsia #E6177F (highlighted headline word, strip pill accents), white #FFFFFF (headline and letter), bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (bold phrases), bottle black #0E0E10, seal gold #D4A437 only for the registration badge border. Secondary support colors for this variation: paper cream #F3E9D2 (instant photo frames) and ink blue #2E4A7D (signature).
global_identity.visual_style: Plain text letter on a deep plum paper-textured background, the real bottle as a sharp cut-out, two taped instant photos.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Intimate, honest and personal, like a note written for her.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat plum background with subtle paper texture, generous white text, bold pink phrases, clear tape pieces on the photos, a slim full-width strip with a white pill and a gold-bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; letter in Poppins Regular with Poppins Bold phrases; signature in a handwritten italic script.

creative_objective: Speak directly to the woman who wants curves but has already decided never to go under the knife: make her feel understood, offer the 3-month plan as her way, and show her own before/after on two different days, without looking like an ad.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline with 'OPERA' in fuchsia; 2) the first lines of the letter; 3) the tilted bottle; 4) the two instant photos; 5) the signature; 6) the bottom strip.
art_direction.composition_style: Like the structure: headline top left, letter on the left 60%, bottle tilted and cut by the right edge, signature under the letter; the two taped instant photos overlap the lower part of the bottle on the right; slim strip at the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 4-20% of the height on the left 4-62%; letter 23-76% on 4-60% of the width with clear gaps between paragraphs; signature 78-84%; bottle 60-100% of the width and 10-62% of the height, cut by the right edge; instant photos 54-86% of the height and 56-96% of the width; strip 88-100%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat even light on the background; the bottle has crisp studio highlights and a soft drop shadow; the instant photos cast a soft drop shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Solid deep background (plum instead of green). Top left: a heavy two-line uppercase headline in white with the word 'OPERA' in fuchsia. Left 60%: a short letter of four paragraphs in white with bold phrases in pink. Right: the real bottle cut out, tilted about 12 degrees, cut by the right edge. Under the letter: the signature in an ink-blue handwritten script on a small cream paper tag. Added (batch rules): two taped instant photos at the lower right overlapping the bottle (her before and her after on two different days) and a slim plum-magenta strip at the bottom with the offer, 'Pagas al recibir' and the gold-bordered badge.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Understands her and explains the plan
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Four short paragraphs with bold phrases

detected_visual_blocks.position: right, tilted, cut by the edge

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Ink-blue script on a cream tag
Same woman; legs and hips; loose jeans before, fitted after
Exact batch offer, 'Pagas al recibir', registration badge

forbidden_additions: 'La oferta se acaba', countdowns or any false urgency
Prices, percentages, 'gratis', guarantee or free shipping claims
Stars, reviews, customer counts or customer names
Needles, syringes, scalpels, hospital images or any medical imagery
Loose capsules, pills or an open bottle

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 text-letter ad. BACKGROUND: solid dark plum #2B1226 with a very subtle paper fiber texture. TOP LEFT (4-20% of the height, 4-62% of the width): a very heavy geometric sans-serif headline (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, left-aligned, two lines: 'PARA LA QUE' in white #FFFFFF and 'NO SE OPERA' with 'NO SE' in white and the highlighted word 'OPERA' in hot fuchsia #E6177F. LETTER (23-76% of the height, 4-60% of the width): four short left-aligned paragraphs in Poppins Regular, white, with clear gaps between them and bold phrases in Poppins Bold bubblegum pink #FF8CC0: paragraph 1 'Sabemos que quieres más curvas, pero no quieres agujas ni quirófano.'; paragraph 2 'Por eso existe AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1: aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra en 2 cápsulas al día.' with 'AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1' and '2 cápsulas al día' in bold pink; paragraph 3 'Un plan de 3 meses para acompañar tus caderas, tu cola y tus piernas, a tu ritmo y sin arriesgar tu salud.' with 'plan de 3 meses' in bold pink; paragraph 4 'Lo pides hoy y lo pagas cuando llega a tu casa.' SIGNATURE (78-84%, left): a small paper cream #F3E9D2 tag with the handwritten italic script 'Tu equipo Aguaje Complex' in ink blue #2E4A7D. RIGHT SIDE: the attached product as a sharp photographic cut-out, tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, about 52% of the canvas height, occupying 60-100% of the width and 10-62% of the height, its right side cut by the canvas edge, with a soft drop shadow; use the attached product image as the only source of truth and do not redesign it: a matte black cylindrical bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides, wide mouth and no neck, a glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body (about 90%) and one fifth of its height with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth, black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and three boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'; the label front-facing and readable; not a slim bottle, not a squat jar; closed, never mirrored; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; no capsules anywhere. INSTANT PHOTOS (54-86% of the height, 56-96% of the width), overlapping the lower part of the bottle, each with a cream #F3E9D2 frame and a piece of clear tape, slightly tilted in opposite directions, both real unretouched phone photos of the SAME adult Colombian woman, 29 years old, light wheat skin with visible pores, ash-blonde hair with dark roots, framed head to knee, on two DIFFERENT DAYS, with tiny handwritten captions on the frame. BACK PHOTO (left, caption 'Antes'): her bathroom in cold bluish morning light, hair in a messy top knot, an oversized grey hoodie and loose faded light-blue jeans one size too big; side-on at hip height with her face to the camera and a disappointed look, her hand pulls the waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap is clearly visible; flat straight hips, thin straight thighs, baggy denim. FRONT PHOTO (right, caption 'Mes 3'): her sunny living room in warm afternoon light, hair loose, long and straight, a light denim shirt open over a white top and black leggings, three-quarter pose facing the camera with a confident smile and a hand on her hip; small waist, hips clearly wider and rounded, toned fuller thighs; the change is clear at first glance but natural. BOTTOM STRIP (88-100%): a slim full-width deep magenta #B0105E strip with, left to right: white Poppins Bold 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses', a white pill with plum Poppins Bold 'Pagas al recibir', and a round badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, plum center and white text 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.

mandatory_visual_elements: Dark plum paper-textured background with the white letter on the left
The real bottle tilted and cut by the right edge, label readable
Two taped instant photos of the same woman on two different days: before with the visible gap in the loose waistband, after with curvy hips and toned legs, facing the camera or three-quarters
Ink-blue signature on a cream tag
Slim strip with the offer, the 'Pagas al recibir' pill and the gold-bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: sin poses de espaldas ni enfoque en zonas del cuerpo
No back views, no close-ups centered on the buttocks or crotch, no lingerie or swimwear
The two instant photos never share the same outfit, pose, hairstyle, place or light
No needles, syringes, hospital or surgery imagery
No prices, percentages, 'gratis', guarantee, free shipping or urgency claims
No stars, reviews, customer counts or names
No logos outside the bottle label
No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add extra buttons, badges, seals or strips beyond the ones described here.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
